segments.HAB.1.1-2: Habakkuk asks the LORD how long he must cry for help
segments.HAB.1.3-4: Habakkuk asks why God allows violence and injustice
segments.HAB.1.5-7: The LORD says he is raising up the Chaldeans
segments.HAB.1.8-9: The Chaldean army is fast and full of violence
segments.HAB.1.10-11: The Chaldeans laugh at kings and fortresses
segments.HAB.1.12-12: Habakkuk says the LORD chose the Chaldeans to judge
segments.HAB.1.13-14: Habakkuk asks why God is silent about the wicked
segments.HAB.1.15-17: Habakkuk asks if the enemy will keep killing nations
segments.HAB.2.1-1: Habakkuk waits to hear how the LORD will answer
segments.HAB.2.2-3: The LORD tells Habakkuk to write the vision and wait
segments.HAB.2.4-5: The proud are not upright, but the righteous live by faith
segments.HAB.2.6-8: The Chaldeans will be robbed as they robbed others
segments.HAB.2.9-11: Woe to those who build a house with unjust gain
segments.HAB.2.12-14: Woe to those who build cities by bloodshed
segments.HAB.2.15-16: Woe to those who make neighbors drunk and ashamed
segments.HAB.2.17-17: Violence against Lebanon will come back on the Chaldeans
segments.HAB.2.18-20: Idols are useless, but the LORD is in his holy temple
segments.HAB.3.1-2: Habakkuk prays that the LORD will show mercy in wrath
segments.HAB.3.3-3: God comes from Teman, and his glory fills the earth
segments.HAB.3.4-5: God shines like sunlight, and plague goes before him
segments.HAB.3.6-6: God measures the earth, and mountains crumble
segments.HAB.3.7-8: Habakkuk sees nations tremble and asks about God’s anger
segments.HAB.3.9-10: Habakkuk says the earth and mountains shake before God
segments.HAB.3.11-12: Sun and moon stand still as God marches in fury
segments.HAB.3.13-13: God goes out to save his people and crush the wicked
segments.HAB.3.14-15: God destroys the enemy leader and tramples the sea
segments.HAB.3.16-16: Habakkuk trembles and will wait for the day of distress
segments.HAB.3.17-17: Habakkuk describes failing crops and empty stalls
segments.HAB.3.18-19: Habakkuk will rejoice in God, who gives him strength
